field_about_portal:
About the Portal

The Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal aggregates, analyzes, and displays human genetic and functional genomic information linked to common metabolic diseases and traits, while protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the underlying data.
field_about_project:
About the project

The ALS Knowledge Portal (ALSKP) framework is being developed by a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard. Data in the ALSKP were generated by the Familial ALS (FALS) and ALS Genetics (ALSGENS) Consortia.

We welcome contributions of data and the involvement of interested researchers in collaborations on analyses, methods, or tool development. Please contact us for more information.
